Join us on Saturday, May 18, from 8 A.M. to 4 P.M. for the opening of our second location at 42 Harbor Street. The first 50 customers will receive a free reusable cup. Present this advertisement to get 20% off any drink all day.

questions.stem: The quarterly report ___ to the board by the end of this week.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'report' chịu tác động nên dùng bị động; 'by the end of this week' chỉ tương lai → 'will be submitted'.

questions.stem: Ms. Alvarez has worked at the company ___ 2015.
questions.explanation: 'since' + mốc thời gian đi với thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.stem: All visitors must wear a badge ___ inside the laboratory.
questions.explanation: 'while' + mệnh đề rút gọn (while [they are] inside); 'during' cần danh từ.

questions.stem: The new software is ___ easier to use than the previous version.
questions.explanation: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho so sánh hơn 'easier' → 'considerably'.

questions.stem: Please review the attached contract and return it with your ___ by Friday.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu 'your' cần danh từ → 'signature'.

questions.stem: Neither the manager ___ the assistants were informed of the schedule change.

questions.explanation: 'from ... through ...' chỉ khoảng thời gian bao gồm cả ngày cuối.

choices: Shuttle buses will run every 15 minutes.
The cafeteria menu has been updated.
questions.explanation: Câu chèn phải liên quan bãi đỗ tạm → xe đưa đón.
Câu mệnh lệnh lịch sự: 'please contact'.
'Thank you for your cooperation' là cụm quen thuộc.

questions.stem: What is indicated about GreenLeaf Café?
choices: It is closing one of its locations.
It has more than one location.
It opens at 4 P.M. on Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 'our second location' → có hơn một cơ sở.
